name: Loyverse
description: Loyverse point of sale: sales and refund receipts, shifts and cash, items with variants, categories, modifiers, discounts and taxes, stock per store, loyalty customers, employees, stores, POS devices, payment types, suppliers and webhooks.
instructions:
## Loyverse
This connector uses the **Loyverse API v1.0** (`https://api.loyverse.com/v1.0`), the back office API of the Loyverse point of sale. It reads sales and refund receipts, shifts, the item catalog with variants, categories, modifiers, discounts and taxes, stock levels per store, customers with loyalty points, employees, stores, POS devices, payment types and suppliers, and it can create and update catalog records, customers and stock and record receipts.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. Sign in to the Loyverse Back Office as the owner and open **Settings**, **Access tokens** (https://r.loyverse.com/dashboard/#/integrations/tokens). Access tokens are part of the Integrations add-on on some plans.
2. Click **Add access token**, give it a name, optionally an expiry date, and save. Copy the token.
3. Paste it into `LOYVERSE_ACCESS_TOKEN`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and has full access to the account, so keep it private.
4. Run `loyverse_get_merchant` to check it.

**Workflow**
- Account and stores: `loyverse_get_merchant` (currency and decimals), `loyverse_list_stores`, `loyverse_get_store`, `loyverse_list_pos_devices`.
- Sales: `loyverse_list_receipts` by store and date range (`created_at_min`/`created_at_max`), `loyverse_get_receipt` by receipt number. `loyverse_create_receipt` records a sale made elsewhere. Shifts and cash: `loyverse_list_shifts`, `loyverse_get_shift`. Payment types: `loyverse_list_payment_types`, `loyverse_get_payment_type`.
- Refunds: `loyverse_refund_receipt` creates a refund receipt for chosen lines of a sale.
- Catalog: `loyverse_list_items`, `loyverse_get_item`, `loyverse_save_item`, `loyverse_delete_item`; variants (SKU, barcode, price per store) with `loyverse_list_variants` (search by `sku`), `loyverse_get_variant`, `loyverse_save_variant`; `loyverse_list_categories`, `loyverse_get_category`, `loyverse_save_category`; `loyverse_list_modifiers`; `loyverse_list_discounts`, `loyverse_get_discount`, `loyverse_save_discount`; `loyverse_list_taxes`, `loyverse_get_tax`, `loyverse_save_tax`; `loyverse_list_suppliers`.
- Stock: `loyverse_list_inventory` gives `in_stock` per variant and store; `loyverse_set_inventory` sets new levels.
- Customers and staff: `loyverse_list_customers` (search by `email`), `loyverse_get_customer`, `loyverse_save_customer`, `loyverse_delete_customer`; `loyverse_list_employees`, `loyverse_get_employee`.
- Webhooks: `loyverse_list_webhooks`, `loyverse_create_webhook` (one event per webhook).

**Switched off at install**: `loyverse_refund_receipt`, `loyverse_delete_item` and `loyverse_delete_customer`; they cannot be undone, so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.

**Before writing**: the save tools create a record without `id` and update it with `id`, and an update replaces the record, so read it first and send every field you want to keep. `loyverse_set_inventory` takes the new absolute quantity in `stock_after`, not a difference. A receipt created through the API reduces stock and counts in reports; confirm lines and payments with the user.

**Reading the answers**: ids are UUIDs, receipts are addressed by `receipt_number` (e.g. 1-1001). Money is a decimal number in the account currency (see `loyverse_get_merchant`). Receipts have `receipt_type` SALE or REFUND; refunds carry positive amounts, so subtract them when you add up sales, and `cancelled_at` marks cancelled receipts. All times are UTC (ISO 8601); convert to the store's time zone before you group by day. Records deleted in the Back Office are hidden unless `show_deleted` is true.

**Paging**: list tools (all but stores, POS devices, payment types, discounts and taxes, which return everything at once) return `limit` records (50 by default, 250 at most) and a `cursor` while more exist; pass it as `cursor` until it is missing.

**Limits and errors**: 300 requests per 300 seconds per account (429 `RATE_LIMITED` above). Errors come as `errors: [{code, details, field}]`: 401 `UNAUTHORIZED` a wrong or expired token, 402 `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` a lapsed subscription or a missing add-on, 403 `FORBIDDEN`, 404 `NOT_FOUND` a wrong id, 400 `INVALID_VALUE` or `MISSING_REQUIRED_PARAMETER` with the field named.
prerequisites: A Loyverse account and a personal access token from the Back Office (Settings, Access tokens).

LOYVERSE_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Access token
LOYVERSE_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: Loyverse Back Office, Settings, Access tokens: add a token and copy it. It has full access to the account.
LOYVERSE_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the access token, without spaces, quotes or a Bearer prefix.

verifyHints.401: Loyverse refused the access token. Copy it again from Settings, Access tokens, or create a new one; an expired token also returns 401.
verifyHints.402: The Loyverse subscription or the add-on that includes the API has lapsed. Check the billing page in the Back Office.
verifyHints.429: Loyverse allows 300 requests per 300 seconds per account. Wait a few minutes and try again.

tools.name: loyverse_get_merchant
tools.description: Get the Loyverse account (merchant) behind the token: business name, email, country and currency with its decimal places. Use it to check the token.

tools.name: loyverse_list_stores
tools.description: List the stores of the account with name, address, phone and description. Store ids filter receipts, shifts, inventory and POS devices.

created_at_min.description: Only records created at or after this UTC time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-03-30T00:00:00.000Z.

created_at_max.description: Only records created at or before this UTC time, ISO 8601.

updated_at_min.description: Only records updated at or after this UTC time, ISO 8601.

updated_at_max.description: Only records updated at or before this UTC time, ISO 8601.

show_deleted.description: true to include soft-deleted records (they carry deleted_at).

tools.name: loyverse_get_store
tools.description: Get one store by its id (UUID) with name, address, phone number and description, as shown in the Back Office.

tools.name: loyverse_list_pos_devices
tools.description: List the POS devices (registers) of the account, optionally for one store, with name, store id and whether the device is activated.

store_id.description: Only devices of this store id.

show_deleted.description: true to include soft-deleted records (they carry deleted_at).

tools.name: loyverse_list_receipts
tools.description: List sales and refund receipts, newest first, with line items, discounts, taxes, payments, totals, store, employee, customer and POS device. Filter by store, date range or receipt numbers.

receipt_numbers.description: Only these receipt numbers, comma-separated, e.g. 1-1001,1-1002.

since_receipt_number.description: Receipts created at or after the receipt with this number.

before_receipt_number.description: Receipts created up to the receipt with this number.

store_id.description: Only receipts of this store id.

order.description: Only receipts with this order name or number (the order field of the receipt).

source.description: Only receipts from this source, e.g. point of sale or the name of the app that created them.

created_at_min.description: Only records created at or after this UTC time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-03-30T00:00:00.000Z.

created_at_max.description: Only records created at or before this UTC time, ISO 8601.

updated_at_min.description: Only records updated at or after this UTC time, ISO 8601.

updated_at_max.description: Only records updated at or before this UTC time, ISO 8601.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous response (its cursor field) to get the next page. Absent in the response on the last page.

tools.name: loyverse_get_receipt
tools.description: Get one receipt by its receipt number (e.g. 1-1001) with all line items, modifiers, discounts, taxes, payments and the refund link.

tools.name: loyverse_create_receipt
tools.description: Record a sales receipt in Loyverse (e.g. a sale made in another channel). Stock is reduced for tracked items. Payments must add up to the receipt total. Confirm the lines and amounts with the user first.

store_id.description: Store id where the sale is recorded.

employee_id.description: Employee id credited with the sale.

order.description: Order name or number to store on the receipt.

source.description: Free text naming where the sale came from, e.g. Online shop.

receipt_date.description: Sale time in UTC, ISO 8601. Default now.

line_items.description: Lines: {variant_id, quantity, price?, cost?, line_note?, line_taxes?: [{id}], line_discounts?: [{id}], line_modifiers?: [{modifier_option_id}]}.

payments.description: Payments: [{payment_type_id, money_amount, paid_at?}]. The sum must equal the receipt total.

tools.name: loyverse_refund_receipt
tools.description: Create a refund receipt for some or all lines of a sales receipt. It cannot be undone and returns money to the customer, so show the lines to the user and wait for a yes.

receipt_number.description: Number of the sales receipt to refund, e.g. 1-1001.

line_items.description: Lines to refund: [{id, quantity}], where id is the line item id from the sales receipt.

store_id.description: Store id where the refund is made (default the store of the sale).

source.description: Free text naming where the refund came from.

receipt_date.description: Refund time in UTC, ISO 8601. Default now.

created_at_min.description: Only shifts opened at or after this UTC time, ISO 8601.

created_at_max.description: Only shifts opened at or before this UTC time, ISO 8601.

tools.description: Get one item by id with its variants, prices per store, category, tax ids, modifier ids, stock tracking and composite components.

tools.name: loyverse_save_item
tools.description: Create an item, or update it when id is given (Loyverse upserts with POST). Send the full item: fields left out on an update are reset. Prices are per variant.

id.description: Item id to update; leave out to create.

use_production.description: Produce composite items in advance (stock of the composite itself).

tax_ids.description: Tax ids applied to the item.

modifiers_ids.description: Modifier ids available on the item.

option1_name.description: Name of the first option, e.g. Size.

form.description: Shape shown on the POS when there is no image.

variants.description: Variants: [{variant_id? (to update), sku, barcode, option1_value, cost, purchase_cost, default_pricing_type: FIXED|VARIABLE, default_price, stores: [{store_id, pricing_type, price, available_for_sale, optimal_stock, low_stock}]}].

tools.name: loyverse_delete_item
tools.description: Delete an item and its variants from the catalog. It cannot be undone through the API, so confirm with the user first.

tools.description: List item variants with SKU, barcode, option values, cost, default price and per-store price and availability. Find a variant by SKU here.

sku.description: Only the variant with this SKU.

created_at_max.description: Only records created at or before this UTC time, ISO 8601.

stores.description: Per store: [{store_id, pricing_type, price, available_for_sale, optimal_stock, low_stock}].
